$comment: Advisories that npm audit reports but which do not apply to Fleet, with the
reason and a date to look again. Anything not listed here fails the build at
An entry is a claim that has to stay true. scripts/audit.mjs fails if an
entry stops matching anything (the advisory was fixed and the exception is
now noise) or if its review date has passed — so this file cannot quietly
become a list of things nobody looked at again.

allow.reason: RSC Mode CSRF bypass. It applies to React Server Components — server-side actions executing before a 400 response. Fleet's frontend is a client-rendered SPA: it mounts BrowserRouter in main.tsx and uses the declarative Routes/Route API only, with no RSC, no server actions and no loaders. The affected code path is not reachable. Clearing the advisory outright needs react-router 8, which requires React >= 19.2.7 while Fleet is on React 18 — a framework upgrade rather than a dependency bump.
